trials.execution: Executed partial fresh-realm provider state against actual archived gkx sources at 1051710191 and 1051908825 through the generic core Subject: 17 cases and 254 probes per revision, 17 unchanged comparisons; 18 tests passed. A private observer retained 34 full content-addressed records before assertions, covering 51 single-revision executions and 762 probes including repeated baseline runs. All 27 frozen inputs remained unchanged. Explicit diagnostic process mode reports isolated:false; no container, original backend/cohort, exposure delivery or production scheduling proof.

trials.domains: Keys, entry/result/metrics values and histories are unbounded; bounded literal/generated characterization. Provider returns result without Boolean coercion. No original Boolean input/key domain is established.
